correction.statement: Kafka 4.0 and newer logs via Log4j2 instead of Reload4j/Log4j1. Environments with custom logging configuration might need to update it during the upgrade to Kafka 4.0. The evidence does not say that anything fails.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade to Kafka 4.0, Kafka logs via Log4j2 instead of Reload4j/Log4j1. The changelog says custom logging configuration might need to be updated during the upgrade. It does not say what happens if it is left unchanged.
consequence.remediation: Review any custom logging configuration and update it for Log4j2 when upgrading to Kafka 4.0, as the changelog advises.
